newsitem.title: USA: U.S. spot LPGs steady in quiet late trade.
newsitem.headline: U.S. spot LPGs steady in quiet late trade.

text.p: U.S. spot liquefied petroleum gas prices were steady in quiet late trade on Wednesday as players stood on the sidelines to watch crude oil.
""There is really no news today. Most people are just watching crude but primarily there is some downside to the market," said one Houston trader.
In the U.S. Gulf Coast, Mont Belvieu, Texas, spot propane held onto the half cent it shed at midday, staying between 33.75 cents and 34.00 cents a gallon. 34.00 cents was done several times.
In the Midwest, Conway, Kansas, spot material remained 34.25/34.50 cents, after losing a quarter cent midday.
The ethane markets were also steady to lower. Belvieu purity was pegged 17.50/17.75 cents and Conway ethane was 13.50/14.00 cents with 13.75 cents done.
Meanwhile, both crude and NYMEX gasoline were off on bearish inventory data for the week ended April 11.
